note: Gilmer County WV has no countywide zoning ordinance (only floodplain, 911 and unsafe-building rules). The only zoning in the county is the City of Glenville's, whose Official Zoning Map (Sec. 152.046) is kept in the Recorder's office; no GIS service, open-data layer or ArcGIS Online zoning layer was found. The county's ArcGIS Online Gilmer_AGOL service holds only parcels, flood zones and wells, no zoning.
